semantics.subset_rule: Canary targets are exact or deterministically selected by declared policy.
semantics.promotion_rule: Promotion uses explicit evidence and does not infer success from elapsed time alone.
semantics.authority_rule: Canary success grants only deployment progression eligibility.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: first target used as canary implicitly
canary success deploys all without plan
